name: @kitchensink/infra-messaging
//exports: Like @kitchensink/infra-security (and unlike most @kitchensink/* packages) this one exports BUILT
JS, not ./src. Its consumers are CDK app entrypoints, and both prod-deploy and sandbox-deploy run
them as COMPILED JS under plain node (`cdk deploy --app "node .../infra/dist/bin/app.js"`). A `main`
of ./src/index.ts makes that path fail with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: node type-strips index.ts but
cannot resolve its `./x.js` relative imports with no built .js beside them. See ADR-0013.
